outcome: annualized relapsing rate (ARR) of multiple sclerosis (MS)
cohort: 93 women with multiple sclerosis (MS) with a history of at least one pregnancy in the last 7 years
finding: Pregnancy was associated with a significant decrease in ARR of MS from the pre-pregnancy period, and exclusive breastfeeding for at least 2 months decreased the risk of postpartum relapse.
followup_time: 2 years preceding conception and up to at least several months postpartum (exact time unclear)
